Name: Gus's Recipes (Consolidated Recipes Shop)
Author: bikinavisho
TagLine: A Consolidated Recipes Shop! Tired of Gus's Store being cluttered by all of the recipes from all of the food mods you installed? Be frustrated no longer! Now, the recipes are sold separate from the rest of his wares!
Description:
Adds a recipe book in Gus's Saloon which has all modded recipes from a large collection of mods that I personally use. If you don't use all the mods it shouldn't cause any issues. It helps separate the large number of modded recipes from Gus's normal selection of goods (food and drink!). 

Requires both [Content Patcher](https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915) and [Shop Tile Framework](https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5005) to function properly! 

Mod Recipes included: 
- Bonster's Recipes
- [Elfin Tea](https://m.blog.naver.com/PostView.naver?blogId=ssm4031&logNo=222230452532&navType=by)
- Forsy's Comfort Foods
- Kaya Jam and South Asia Dessert
- Korea Blossom
- Milkshakes
- TeaTime
- Turkish Dessert
- Artisan Valley
- Even More Recipes 
- Farmer to Florist
- Fresh Meat
- More Recipes 
- Cherry Blossom Cafe
- Regional Cuisine Korean Preserve
- SSaturn's Oriental Kitchen
- SSaturn's Tropical Farm
- Sweet Tooth

Thanks to donko526 for the [inspiration](https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/9066), I rewrote their entire mod from the ground up to get what you see today. There aren't any restrictions on buying any of the recipes unlike in their rendition. 


Mods pictured in the screenshots:
- [Fashion Sense](https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/9969)
- [[FS] Kisekae's skirts](https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/10312)
- [[FS] Rural Outfitters](https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/9969)
- [Garden Variety UI](https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1358)
-  [Better Shop Menu](https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2012)
